title: JetBlue's Creditors Call a Lawyer, Lufthansa Buys TAP, and a 737 Fleet Gets Grounded for Inspections
summary: JetBlue's bondholders just hired bankruptcy advisers while the stock sits at an all-time low — we break down what that actually means. Plus, Lufthansa beats Air France-KLM for a chunk of TAP Air Portugal, nearly 2,000 Boeing 737s need emergency tail inspections, Riyadh Air literally can't fly out of Riyadh anymore, and a flight attendant who was once told she wasn't "American material" retires after 63 years with the receipts to prove them wrong.
